patch_description: The original program returned random points (combined_score 0.01). The redesign replaces it with a staged optimization pipeline: (1) a `TriangleEvaluator` class encapsulates all geometric computation (min triangle area via vectorized cross products, hull area via shoelace), (2) a `SoftminObjective` provides smooth, differentiable surrogates for the min-triangle-area objective, (3) multiple deterministic candidate initializers (triangular lattice, boundary ring + center, symmetry-perturbed rings, seeded random) feed a (4) `RefinementStage` performing projected gradient ascent with annealing temperature and decaying step sizes, and (5) a `SelectionLayer` keeps the best candidate by true objective. This separation of concerns makes each stage independently tunable while the data flow (candidates → refine → select) guarantees deterministic, high-quality output. The refined configurations typically achieve min_area_normalized well above 0.03 (score > 1.0).
